label: sets the price of every crossing at
notes: It owns no wagons; it owns the right to what the wagons carry, and its counting-house on the quay assays the salt and prices the crossing. Bell Harrow sets what a crossing is worth and Tallow Reach takes what arrives, so a grip on the north rim is a grip on the whole Road. The chapter 1 loading happens under that price whether or not anyone says so.
